summary: Implemented SHACL path parsing. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError, and test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py with 41 new tests. Those tests plus test/test_path.py pass (42 passed) using the prepared venv. Not verified: mypy type checking (not installed in the venv, so the type-ignore comments and the unreachable-guard check are unconfirmed), and black/isort formatting (not installed; line lengths checked manually, all within 88 columns). No commits made; no core, __init__, or existing test files changed.
